authority_layer_note: http_live_device_replay and http_live_end_barrier are enforced by the live session service authority layer against the persisted session (hosted_live_receipt / end_barrier) and are reflected in the live_capture_result / live_session_view outcomes. validate_http_semantics validates request bodies and path/body equality; it does not re-validate response views, so these two rules are not mandatory with the JSON schema alone.

algorithms.operation_digest: payload_digest is lowercase SHA-256 over canonical JSON of the request body excluding the closed meta envelope (contract_name, contract_version, request_id, idempotency_key, payload_digest, operation_request).
algorithms.bound_digest: The persisted live receipt digest additionally binds campaign_id, base_revision, session_id, controller_id, controller_epoch, expected_workflow_version, event_type, event_id, device_id, operation_id, device_order, text, and optional record_id (Blocker F3.1). Reusing an operation id on a different device or session is never an exact replay.
algorithms.replay: capture() consults the persisted session-local receipt BEFORE controller authority checks. An identical bound operation already acknowledged returns exact_replay idempotently (including after takeover).
algorithms.replay_after_takeover: Because the bound digest includes controller identity and epoch, replaying an acknowledged operation_id under a changed controller epoch or controller identity produces a differing bound digest and therefore idempotency_digest_conflict, never stale_controller. The stale_controller category is reserved for authority checks on a not-yet-acknowledged operation.
algorithms.session_binding: Mutations must reference the active session belonging to the route campaign; a body/path campaign mismatch or a session_id belonging to another campaign is rejected as unsafe_binding. This rule is enforced by the live session service authority layer on the persisted session, not by the JSON schema alone.
algorithms.end_barrier: end() computes readiness using exact {device_id, operation_id} receipt identities before adding the end receipt, and rejects any proposal omitting an already-acknowledged capture. Required identities are closed objects, unique, and the exact end identity may not appear; another device may reuse the same operation_id.
algorithms.read_only_get: GET /campaigns/{campaign_id}/live/session is strictly read-only and accepts no query parameters (parse_flat_query rejects unknown parameters as invalid_query_binding). It never mutates persisted state; head reporting and other mutations require the CSRF-gated POST mutation routes.
